d:
CM Samrat Speech: hajipur men nitish setu ke udghatan karyakram ke dauran mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne piem narendr modi ke samne bihar men hue vikas karyon ka hisab diya. samrat chaudhri ne relve, sarak, udyog aur rojgar se jure aankre ginae, vahin SIR aur kangres ke mudde par rahul gandhi samet vipaksh par jamkar nishana sadha. dekhie piem modi ke samne samrat chaudhri ka pura bhashan aur vipaksh ko diya gaya javab.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
